installation.heading: Reference versions (June 2026)
installation.commands:
dkp-pacman -Q libnx switch-sdl2
dkp-pacman -Syu    # pull newer libnx / switch-sdl2 when available

installation.heading: 2. Install Switch libraries
installation.commands: dkp-pacman -S switch-dev switch-sdl2 switch-mesa switch-glm switch-freetype switch-harfbuzz

installation.heading: Desktop (optional)
installation.commands:
make desktop
./build/NXSand
make test         # CPU reference tests, no GPU

installation.heading: Desktop (optional)
installation.commands: pacman -S --needed mingw-w64-x86_64-gcc mingw-w64-x86_64-make mingw-w64-x86_64-SDL2 mingw-w64-x86_64-freetype mingw-w64-x86_64-angleproject
